metadata.name: bordrless_launch
metadata.description: The Bordrless launchpad: creates a Bordrless Token Standard token with the rules it fixes at launch (installing the kit as its token hook when it has any) and its curve pool on the Bordrless DEX, runs the sniper fee, the creator fee, the holder fee and the burn as the pool's hook, graduates the pool with locked liquidity and pays creators.

docs: Instructions of the launchpad.

instructions.name: after_swap
docs: Pool hook: a buy's burn; a sell's creator and holder fees, from the output the DEX hands
on. On a slot launch, then each pool item (Hookwars M3b).

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch of the base mint. Only `create_launch` creates a `Launch`, at
`["launch", mint]` with that mint, so the owner, the discriminator and the mint bind it
without a derivation.

accounts.name: holder_vault
docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: rewards are on.

instructions.name: before_initialize
docs: Pool hook: refuses pools with this hook that this program did not create.

instructions.name: before_swap
docs: Pool hook: the anti-sniper LP fee; a buy's creator and holder fees, a sell's burn. On a
slot launch, then each pool item (Hookwars M3b).

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch of the base mint. Only `create_launch` creates a `Launch`, at

without a derivation.

docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

fixed once created, for launches to use by its key.

docs: Creates a token and its curve pool, from the inline rules or from a `LaunchConfig`. With
a custom hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it,
its registry for the mint and the registry's extras.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Graduates a launch whose pool has raised the threshold. Permissionless. With a custom
hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it and the
registry's extras.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever cranks it; pays only the network fee.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch (only `create_launch` creates one, at its PDA).

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: extras on the reserve's transfer and burn).

accounts.name: kit_caller
docs: kit's `graduate`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates the config; signed by the program's upgrade authority, once.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority, paying the rent.

instructions.name: prepare_launch
docs: Hookwars M3b: the first step of a slot launch: the slot mint (the kit Locked in slot 0 when
the rules install a kit module), no supply, the launch PDA as its only mint authority.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator: pays the rent; the only signer the later steps accept.

instructions.name: refresh_pool_registry
docs: Hookwars M3b: rewrites a slot launch's pool registry from its slot table. Permissionless.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays any rent the registry grows by.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Admin: changes the config. Launches keep the terms they were created with.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin.

errors.msg: a holder fee is above the maximum

errors.name: BurnTooHigh
errors.msg: a burn is above the maximum

errors.msg: max wallet must be off or within the bounds

errors.name: CreatorLockTooLong
errors.msg: the creator wallet lock is longer than the maximum

errors.name: InvalidEarlyLock
errors.msg: the early-buyer lock needs a window within the maximum and an unlock after it, within the maximum

errors.msg: a launch with kit rules needs the kit's accounts

errors.name: UnexpectedKitAccounts

errors.msg: the holder vault passed is not the launch's

errors.msg: a config with a custom hook can have no kit rule (holder rewards, max wallet, the locks)

errors.msg: the custom hook must be an executable program that is none of the protocol's

errors.msg: the custom hook's flags must name at least one callback and no unknown bit

errors.msg: the custom hook has no registry for this mint: prepare the hook for the mint first

errors.name: HookExtrasMismatch
errors.msg: the custom hook's extra accounts do not match its registry

errors.name: CustomHookAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch with a custom hook needs the hook's accounts

errors.name: UnexpectedCustomHookAccounts
errors.msg: custom hook accounts were passed for a launch without one

errors.name: ConfigMismatch
errors.msg: the arguments do not match the launch config

errors.name: WrongHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer passed is not the token program's signer for the custom hook

errors.name: InvalidLabel
errors.msg: the label is longer than 32 bytes

errors.name: InvalidAuthorShare
errors.msg: a listed config's author share is between 1 and 5,000 basis points of the creator fee

errors.name: NoAuthorShare
errors.msg: this launch pays no config author

errors.name: AuthorAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch that pays its config's author needs the config and the author's holding

errors.name: NotAuthor
errors.msg: the signer is not the config's author

errors.name: HookUpgradeable
errors.msg: the custom hook can be upgraded by someone other than Bordrless: make it immutable or deploy it with Studio

errors.name: HookProgramDataMissing
errors.msg: the custom hook's program data account is missing or wrong

errors.name: InvalidSlots
errors.msg: the slot table is not one a launch can make (an item slot of the Locked kind, too many slots)

errors.name: NotPrepared
errors.msg: this mint has no prepared launch, or it has already launched

errors.name: WrongCreator

errors.name: PreparedMismatch

errors.name: StaleRegistry

errors.name: ItemCutWrongSide
errors.msg: a pool item may cut only the quote: a buy's input or a sell's output

errors.name: ItemBurnWrongSide
errors.msg: a pool item may burn only the base, and only where its slot allows a burn

errors.name: ItemCutOutOfBounds

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

docs: Base burned at graduation.

docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: slot_launch
docs: Hookwars M3b: `constants::hookwars::SLOT_LAUNCH` when the launch was made with
`prepare_launch` and `create_prepared_launch` (its mint runs a slot table, its pool hook
forwards to pool items); 0 otherwise. Taken from `reserved`, so `Launch::LEN` is unchanged.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: A launch config (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.7): the rules, the creator fee and, for a
build-your-own token, the creator's own token hook, made with the SDK by anyone as a keypair
account (so its key can be shared and pasted), fixed once created and usable for any number of
launches. `create_launch` takes one as an optional account; without one the rules come inline.
A config can never touch the protocol's share.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who made it.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules (within the launch config's bounds when made, checked again at launch).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook program (§5.8), when the config is for a build-your-own
token; then no kit module may be on (one token hook per mint). The mint is created with it
and no hook authority.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The hook's flags (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`); 0 without a custom hook.

fields.name: label
docs: A short name, for the site.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: A listed config's author share (`create_listed_config`): the part of the creator fee, in
basis points of it (at most `MAX_AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS`), paid to `creator` (the config's
author) on every launch made from it by someone else. Fixed at creation; 0 for a config
made with `create_config`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchConfigCreated

fields.name: rules

fields.name: modules

fields.name: kit_config
docs: The token's `KitConfig` when it has a kit.

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: Where holder fees go (the kit's reward vault) when holder rewards are on.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from, when it was.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook, when the token has one.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: Its flags; 0 without one.

types.name: LaunchPrepared
docs: Hookwars M3b: a slot launch prepared (`prepare_launch`): the mint exists with its slot table
and no supply.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

default key on initialize.

fields.name: direction
docs: Swap direction: 0 base → quote (a sell), 1 quote → base (a buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Swap input (after any before-delta, before fees); liquidity base amount.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Swap output (known after); liquidity quote amount.

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: Real quote reserve.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base offset.

fields.name: virtual_quote

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: The pool's LP fee (after a swap: the fee actually applied).

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: The pool's protocol fee.

fields.name: swap_count
docs: Swaps so far (before this one).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Pool creation time.

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: LP amount of a liquidity operation.

fields.name: hook_data
docs: Opaque data from the caller (v4's `hookData`). The trader writes it freely: never read a
route or any fact from it.

fields.name: route
docs: Hookwars (spec 03 section 3.2, R5): the route of the swap this callback is part of, filled
only by the DEX. A plain swap is a one-hop route; liquidity and initialize callbacks carry
`hop_count` 0.

types.name: PoolItemCuts
docs: Hookwars M3b: what the pool items of a slot launch answered in one callback (side 0: input,
1: output). Logged (`emit!`), not a self-CPI, so a swap's trace grows only by the items' own
calls. `pool_cuts_delta` is the one merged delta to the `PoolCuts` holding.

types.name: PoolItemPart
docs: Hookwars M3b: one pool item's part of a callback.

types.name: PoolOp
docs: What a pool hook is being told about.

types.name: PoolRegistryRefreshed
docs: Hookwars M3b: the pool registry of a slot launch rewritten from its slot table.

types.name: PrepareLaunchArgs
docs: Arguments of `prepare_launch`.

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: The creator fee the launch will have (checked again at launch).

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules the launch will have; when they install a kit module, the kit is Locked in
slot 0 with exactly the flags those modules need.

fields.name: slots
docs: The item slots, after the kit's (none of them `Locked`). Their kind, rule, bounds and data
range are fixed for ever.

types.name: PreparedLaunch
docs: Hookwars M3b: a slot launch between `prepare_launch` and `create_prepared_launch`, at
`["prepared", mint]`. It fixes who may equip and launch the mint and with which rules.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who prepared it: the only signer `equip_prepared` and `create_prepared_launch` accept.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules the launch will have (the kit's slot was made from their modules).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: The creator fee the launch will have.

fields.name: slot_count
docs: Slots in the mint's table (the kit's included).

fields.name: prepared_at
docs: When it was prepared.

fields.name: launched
docs: Set by `create_prepared_launch`; a prepared launch launches once.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: RouteContext
docs: Hookwars: the route of a swap, as the DEX tells each hop's pool hook (spec 03 section 3.2).

fields.name: route_input_mint
docs: The mint the trader started with (the first hop's input).

fields.name: route_output_mint
docs: The mint the trader ends with (the last hop's output).

fields.name: first_pool
docs: The pool of the first hop.

fields.name: route_amount_in
docs: What the first hop took from the trader, in `route_input_mint` units.

fields.name: hop_index
docs: This hop, from 0.

fields.name: hop_count
docs: How many hops; 0 on liquidity and initialize callbacks (not a swap).

types.name: RuleBounds
docs: The bounds `create_launch` holds token rules to (§5.2), kept in the [`Config`]. `init_config`
and `set_config` keep each within the hard ceilings of [`crate::constants::ceilings`].

fields.name: max_holder_fee_bps
docs: Largest holder fee per side.

fields.name: max_burn_bps
docs: Largest burn per side.

fields.name: max_rules_fee_bps
docs: Largest creator fee + holder fee + burn on one side.

fields.name: min_max_wallet_bps
docs: Smallest max wallet (when on).

fields.name: max_max_wallet_bps
docs: Largest max wallet.

fields.name: max_creator_lock_secs
docs: Longest creator wallet lock.

fields.name: max_early_window_secs
docs: Longest early-buyer window.

fields.name: max_early_lock_secs
docs: Latest early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch.

types.name: SlotBounds
docs: Bounds a slot keeps for life.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: Most an item in this slot may cut from one transfer, in bps of the amount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Whether an item may refuse operations (declared; not enforceable at run time).

fields.name: may_write_data
docs: Whether an item may write this slot's hook-data range.

fields.name: may_answer_touch
docs: Whether an item may answer `touch`.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Hookwars R21: Pool slots only: whether an item may burn part of a swap (through the
launchpad's pool-slot forwarding, M3b).

types.name: SlotInit
docs: One slot of a new slot table.

fields.name: kind
docs: `bordrless_hook::slot_kind`.

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: `bordrless_hook::equip_rule`.

fields.name: bounds
docs: Bounds for life.

fields.name: data_len
docs: Item slots: range length including the epoch byte, or 0. Locked: the legacy program's
range from byte 0 (the kit: 32), or 0.

fields.name: locked_program
docs: Locked slot only: the legacy program.

fields.name: locked_flags
docs: Locked slot only: its upstream token flags.

fields.name: locked_extra_count
docs: Locked slot only: how many extra accounts it takes (its registry's length).
